name: LEGO Immersive Christmas House
context: Client project at ByondXR for the LEGO Group: a holiday-season immersive shopping experience on ByondXR's user-engagement platform.
summary: An immersive, gamified holiday shopping experience built with the LEGO Group: a virtual Christmas house — twinkling lights, a cozy fireplace — with rooms full of LEGO builds and a treasure quest that unlocks a special dream zone. Experiential and gamified shopping in one branded world, in the spirit of 'play well'.
